verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.

xrefs.text: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.

verses.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.

xrefs.text: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth— let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.
And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder. And the sound I heard was like harpists strumming their harps.

verses.text: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.

xrefs.text: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
Together with their relatives, who were all trained and skillful in the songs of the LORD, they numbered 288.
Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.

verses.text: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.

xrefs.text: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

verses.text: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.

xrefs.text: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.

verses.text: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.

xrefs.text: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.

verses.text: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.

xrefs.text: At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up; like a wall the currents stood firm; the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.

the flowing water stood still. It backed up as far upstream as Adam, a city in the area of Zarethan, while the water flowing toward the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD— the Lord of all the earth— touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.”
And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.” And it was so.
You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.

xrefs.text: Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth— to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?

verses.text: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.

xrefs.text: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
“Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.
For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.

verses.text: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.

xrefs.text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.
who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who confounds the wise and turns their knowledge into nonsense,
There is no wisdom, no understanding, no counsel that can prevail against the LORD.
Now someone told David: “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” So David pleaded, “O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!”

verses.text: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.

xrefs.text: Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’
But He is unchangeable, and who can oppose Him? He does what He desires.
The LORD of Hosts has sworn: “Surely, as I have planned, so will it be; as I have purposed, so will it stand.
Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?

verses.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!

xrefs.text: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit— fruit that will remain— so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.

Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is the shield that protects you, the sword in which you boast. Your enemies will cower before you, and you shall trample their high places.”

verses.text: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.

xrefs.text: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.
The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.

For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”

verses.text: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.

xrefs.text: be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and act, and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart— for You alone know the hearts of all men—
So Jesus told them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place. May You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place. May You hear and forgive.

verses.text: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.

xrefs.text: the One great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are on all the ways of the sons of men, to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
But they fail to consider in their hearts that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds are all around them; they are before My face.
would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?

Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
Only this have I found: I have discovered that God made mankind upright, but they have sought out many schemes.”

verses.text: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.

xrefs.text: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
This is what the LORD says: “Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor the strong man in his strength, nor the wealthy man in his riches.
For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
Then the LORD said to Gideon, “You have too many men for Me to deliver Midian into their hands, lest Israel glorify themselves over Me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’
The waters flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen— the entire army of Pharaoh that had chased the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.

verses.text: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.

xrefs.text: A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD.
Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Do you give strength to the horse or adorn his neck with a mane?
Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.”

verses.text: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion

xrefs.text: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
He does not take His eyes off the righteous, but He enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.

verses.text: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

xrefs.text: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
He will rescue you from six calamities; no harm will touch you in seven.
I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat? or ‘What shall we drink? or ‘What shall we wear?

verses.text: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

xrefs.text: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.

verses.text: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.

xrefs.text: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”

verses.text: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.

xrefs.text: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.
But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
